title: Cavalieri slicing of Euclidean balls: L^{d+m}(B_ρ) = ∫_{ℝ^d} L^m(B_{√(ρ²−‖σ‖²)}) dσ
statement: For all d, m ∈ ℕ and ρ ≥ 0, the Lebesgue measure of the open ball B_ρ(0) ⊂ ℝ^{d+m} (Euclid (d + m)) equals ∫_{ℝ^d} L^m(B_{√(ρ² − ‖σ‖²)}(0)) dL^d(σ), the inner balls lying in ℝ^m (Euclid m); here √ = Real.sqrt (√c = 0 for c ≤ 0) and B_0(0) = ∅.
lean_statement: ∀ (d m : ℕ) (ρ : ℝ), 0 ≤ ρ → volume (ball (0 : Euclid (d + m)) ρ) = ∫⁻ σ : Euclid d, volume (ball (0 : Euclid m) (Real.sqrt (ρ ^ 2 - ‖σ‖ ^ 2)))
